name: pm-daci-decision
description: Sets up one product decision with the DACI roles, producing the decision question and options, the driver, approver, contributors and informed list, the inputs, and a decision date. Use for "run pm-daci-decision", "who decides this", "cannot get sign-off", "decision keeps getting reversed", "DACI for this decision", "set up a decision", "who is the approver", part of the AI for Product Management Pack by 90n.
